proposed_decision.rule: Adopt the governed A1 lexeme-authoring pipeline for the 464 approved semantic slots: semantic-slot-first, G-ID-first, authoritative IPA, CANDIDATE-first, explicit provenance, collision/morphology/romanization review, human semantic-form selection, and separate later authority promotion.

governance_decisions.proposal: Adopt NATIVE_PRIMITIVE_CANDIDATE as the default lane. No resemblance to -VAN, final -I, PAR-, VAM-/VAMA-, SAR- or PARAZAMO/PARAZAMI licenses productive derivation without a separate morphology rule.

Adopt the phonological authoring contract from Phonotactic Profile V2: all 40 G-IDs available; G40 /y/ remains vowel and distinct from G16 /j/; TS=G30 atomic; adjacent vowels and final consonants allowed; CV-rich/simple shapes are preferences, not laws; stress unresolved by default.

Adopt romanization honesty: 40/40 G-ID representation is lossless; only governed safe romanization may be shown. Candidates using unmapped G-IDs remain G-ID+IPA rather than receiving invented Latin mappings.
Adopt exact-collision rejection and near-collision/morphology-false-friend review. Each slot receives 2-3 reviewed candidate options and requires explicit human selection before registration.

Adopt 12 authoring waves sized 40×11 + 24. HNK40 organizes batch quantity only and does not select forms or meanings. A human-approved registered governed CANDIDATE may receive one HNK3000 credit; FROZEN promotion remains a separate gate.

governance_decisions.approval_rule: A future SIGA may approve only DEC-HNK3000-A1-AUTHORING-001 through DEC-HNK3000-A1-AUTHORING-006 if this gate remains materially unchanged. The same SIGA must not generate or select any new HNK form, assign any new G-ID sequence, resolve HOLD seeds, approve B16, or alter L03 curriculum/runtime.
